people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses. About three thousand men fell of the people that day.
translations.bsb: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead.
translations.kjv: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
translations.asv: And the sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
